name: Nauders Dreiländereck
kurzbeschreibung: The Dreiländerstein near Nauders marks the border point where Austria, Switzerland and Italy meet.
beschreibung:
The Dreiländerstein near Nauders marks the point where the borders of Austria, Switzerland and Italy meet. It stands at over 2,000 metres above sea level on the slope of the Piz Lad and is a popular hiking destination in the three-country region at the Reschen Pass.

The classic tour starts at the Mutzkopf mountain station and leads past the Schwarzer See and the Grünsee, across the Gufrawiesen meadows, to the stone. The borders of the three countries are precisely marked on the stone. As a reward, a sweeping view awaits over the Lower Engadine with the Muttler as well as over the Tyrolean Upper Inn Valley near Finstermünz.
